child_window: No child observation window is created in V1. Consequently no data can be silently extended beyond proposed child endpoints.
finer_data: May be supplied by a later explicit workflow, but availability alone is not visibility or lower degree.
p023: Only an exact existing subject-bound P023 unresolved result may support UNRESOLVED_FINER_DATA_REQUIRED. This evaluator does not mutate or rerun P023 and never converts finer-data availability into VISIBLE.
